_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil at Disbelief floor with missing blow-off heat and no confirmed breaker; base rate favors HOLD until flows/momentum or VIX resolve the divergence.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst clear on HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase so partial agreement only on non-directional posture
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 50-62 with 30d momentum below 70 and funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 63 on rising ETF flows and momentum, or drops below 47 with VIX/skew spike and weaker CVD
